صَنَّاجَةٌ : see the next preceding paragraph. ―
-b2- صَنَّاجَةُ الجَيْشِ means (assumed tropical:) The singer of the army: ―
-b3- and also (assumed tropical:) The well-known بَطَل [or man of courage or valour] (Har p. 617.) ―
-b4- Aashà- Benee-Keys, (L, K,) also called Aashà-Bekr, (L,) used to be called صَنَّاجَةُ العَرَبِ because of the excellence of his poetry, (L, K,) or because his poetry was much sung. (Har ubi suprà.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
